name: Ooredoo Maldives Data Center (OMDC) 2, Kulhudhuffushi
notes: Uptime Institute awards/tier-achievement registry lists Ooredoo Maldives Data Center (OMDC) 2, client Ooredoo Maldives Public Limited Company, location Kulhudhuffushi, Maldives - first official evidence of a data-centre facility at Kulhudhuffushi beyond the 2024 PEACE cable landing (which remains connectivity evidence only). APAC Outlook describes a second Ooredoo DC being built as backup to OMDC; DataCenterMap labels the facility 'Syntys Maldives 2' at Ameenee Magu, Kulhudhuffushi (directory, C-grade, unverified). Status recorded as construction per trade profile; the specific Uptime award type was not rendered on the page so certification stage is unverified. No public MW disclosed.

name: Dhiraagu N. Velidhoo Data Centre
notes: Dhiraagu's third data centre and first in the atolls, inaugurated in N. Velidhoo (Noonu / South Miladhunmadulu) in Nov 2025; Dhiraagu official press-releases page lists 'Dhiraagu Inaugurates their Third Data Centre, in N. Velidhoo'; DCD and MNN covered the launch; Hotelier Maldives describes it as the first atoll-based Tier III data centre in Maldives (Tier III 'level/ready' marketing, not independently certified). No public MW disclosed; DSCoM domestic-cable Velidhoo node is connectivity context only.

name: Dhiraagu Hulhumale Data Center
notes: Maldives' first and only Uptime Tier IV certified data centre (Certification of Constructed Facility per Dhiraagu official milestones page and Uptime Institute award list for Dhiraagu Hulhumale Data Center, Dhivehi Raajjeyge Gulhun PLC), located at Lot 21563 Dhunburigas Magu, Hulhumale; DCD reported launch. Tier IV certification is a reliability/design signal, not an IT-load figure - no public MW disclosed, capacity_mw null.

name: Ooredoo Maldives Data Centre (OMDC), Hulhumale
notes: Tier-3-ready data centre launched March 2021 in the Hulhumale smart city; Ooredoo Maldives 2021 directors' report (official) confirms OMDC established in Hulhumale as a tier-3-ready data centre; trade coverage (IntelligentDataCentres, Times of Addu) dates the launch to 2021-03-19/23. Flood-resistant design reported by trade sources. Tier III 'ready/standard' is marketing, distinct from independently certified Tier IV (Dhiraagu). No public MW; Ooredoo official colocation service page https://www.ooredoo.mv/business/hosting-services/datacenter-colocation is the current service offering.

name: HDC Development of Co-Location Data Centre in Hulhumale (EOI)
developer: Housing Development Corporation (HDC); investor to be selected via EOI
notes: HDC official announcement page for the Expression of Interest for Development of Co-Location Data Centre in Hulhumale (2021). Pipeline/watch: no operating facility page confirmed; HDC-Maxcom agreement and Maxcom-Vertiv edge/modular data centre partnership are reported (trade) but no confirmed operating colocation facility; keep as announced/pipeline.

name: MVIX Maldives Internet Exchange
notes: Active IXP/colo/peering facility in Male at H. Bonthi 5th Floor, Hihfaseyha Goalhi, Male (official MVIX location page); PCH lists MVIX active, established 2022-09-28. Counted as IXP/colo facility per methodology, not a commercial wholesale DC. No public MW.

name: NCIT / Maldives Digital Service government data centre
developer: Government of Maldives (NCIT, succeeded by Maldives Digital Service per Directive No. 4/2026)
notes: Government-owned NCIT data centre in Male (built ~2005 for e-government workloads) confirmed available to government agencies at no fee by the UNDP State of Digital Government 2025 report; NCIT was dissolved and replaced by Maldives Digital Service (MDS) on 2026-01-15 under Presidential Directive No. 4/2026 (DMADD stakeholders page, MMTV). Current live-operation status under MDS needs an official MDS facility page for A-grade confirmation; recorded as operational historical government DC (B).

name: Dhiraagu legacy core data centre (Male)
notes: Legacy Dhiraagu core data centre in Male city reported in trade/directory summaries predating the Hulhumale and Velidhoo facilities; exact address and current commercial status not confirmed by a primary source (facility_unverified). Directory-only lead, kept for completeness.
